entities.name: EFO_0009363
observations: Chronic central serous retinopathy; Open Targets description identifies this as the chronic form of central serous retinopathy.

entities.name: ARMS2
observations: AMD susceptibility locus; rs10490924 was associated with cCSC in a 292-patient case-control study, with OR 0.64 (PMID:25439433).

entities.name: CFH
observations: AMD-associated complement locus implicated in cCSC; 2015 CFH variants/haplotype included both risk and protective associations, and 2023 GWAS replicated the CFH locus with opposite-direction associations between CSC and AMD (PMID:25439433; PMID:37079300).

entities.name: PMID:25439433
observations: Case-control study: 292 cCSC, 1,147 AMD, and 1,311 controls; ARMS2 rs10490924 significant after correction (OR 0.64); CFH variants showed risk/protective associations, including protective CFH-H3 (OR 0.54).

entities.name: PMID:37079300
observations: Three-cohort genetics study identified shared CSC-AMD loci; CFH and NOTCH4 associations were opposite in direction; AMD polygenic score predicted lower CSC risk (OR 0.76 per SD, 95% CI 0.70–0.83).
